card.name: Web page section headings and labels
card.fires_on: Words that end a heading or label on web pages, such as Restrictions after Usage, Conditions after Growing, releases after press, and database after native plant. Also seen on a comma after a date and on Issue in a citation.

modes.label: Section label words
modes.description: The last word of a heading or field name on a plant, news or press web page, right before the content it introduces.
modes.example: Growing<< Conditions>>Water Use: Low Soil Moist

modes.label: Press release wording
modes.description: The word releases in phrases about press or news releases.
modes.example: EMBL press and picture<< releases>> including photographs, graphics, movies and videos

modes.label: Date and citation punctuation
modes.description: A comma after a posted date or the word Issue in a journal reference.

card.plain: It marks the end of a page heading or field label, just before the details it introduces.
